content:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — Trident POC kickoff tomorrow 9:00am PT. Customer wants drop-in behaviour for their /v1/generate and identical token billing numbers. Also flagged enterprise blockers: SSO + dedicated capacity SLA. Adding questions below, plz chime in.

alex_se: thanks — can we get their current request/response examples? we should map fields first.

maria_sales: posted their sample convo in the drive: https://redwood.atl/drive/trident-sample (see generate.json).

alex_se: initial mapping notes: Trident uses `prompt` + `max_tokens` + `stop`. Our API uses `input`, `token_limit`, and `stop_sequences`. propose shim:
```json
{
  "input": request.prompt,
  "token_limit": request.max_tokens,
  "stop_sequences": request.stop
}
```
keep temp/seed mapping: temp -> temperature, seed -> deterministic flag.

kevin_eng: important: temperature semantics differ slightly — Trident clamps to 0.0-1.0, ours is 0-2.0. recommended: if temp<=1 map directly, if >1 scale down + note in headers so we can debug parity deltas.

josh_sre: capacity note — they want predictable latency for 1k rps baseline during business hours. we need a Dedicated reservation for the POC or a burst policy. can we get committed gpus for the week of the POC?

maria_sales: they asked for price delta if we include dedicated vs hosted. finance asked for an estimate by EOD.

kevin_eng: rough numbers: hosted (shared) likely 20-30% cheaper short-term; Dedicated reserved pool + priority routing adds 40-60% on top but hits latency SLO. I'll send a mini calc.

nina_security: security blockers from their checklist: 1) SSO via SAML, 2) data residency EU-only, 3) KMS integration, 4) SOC2 attestation copies. I attached the Trident security questionnaire answers — we should fill gaps.

maria_sales: @nina_security can you own the questionnaire? customer expects answers 48h after kickoff.

nina_security: taking it. quick Q: are we ok with EU residency on Private deployment or do they insist on hosted EU?

josh_sre: Private (VPC) supports EU residency and KMS, but setup time is ~3 business days for onboarding + networking. if they need <48h we need to do hosted with region restriction and written contractual controls — slower on audit items.

alex_se: on response parity: we saw output tokenization differences in case of multi-byte whitespace and list formatting. plan: 1) canonicalize whitespace and punctuation during post-process, 2) align stop token handling (post-truncate on first stop token). this should reduce customer-visible deltas.

kevin_eng: another trick: add a X-Compat-Mode header so we can enable shim transforms server-side for the POC only. helps us toggle behavior without code deploy.

opsbot: smoke-tests: compat-shim branch deployed to staging — all smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:.

maria_sales: perfect. action items:
- @alex_se: produce field-mapping doc + sample shim config (owner) — due tomorrow 8am PT
- @kevin_eng: pricing delta calc + dedicated capacity estimate — due EOD today
- @nina_security: fill security questionnaire answers + KMS checklist — due 48h
- @josh_sre: confirm onboarding lead time and any network IP allowlists we need — due tomorrow 9am PT

alex_se: ACK, will drop the mapping and an example config snippet (include header toggles).

nina_security: ACK, starting questionnaire now. will flag any 'no' answers.

josh_sre: ACK. will also include recommended SLA fallback (region fallback plan) if Dedicated not ready.

maria_sales: thanks all — i'll prep presales pricing slide for tomorrow call. :thumbsup:

kevin_eng: FYI: we should also capture token billing parity test cases (same prompt, seed, stop) — I'll add a small harness to compare tokens and costs.

alex_se: good call. sample test command for our shim:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/compat/trident/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -H "X-Compat-Mode: trident-v1" 
 -d '{"prompt":"hello\nlist:","max_tokens":50,"temperature":0.7}'
```

maria_sales: anyone see any other enterprise blockers?

nina_security: export controls question came up (customer in fintech). added to questionnaire.

maria_sales: ok closing loop here. will follow up with a short pre-kickoff doc in the drive and ping when slide is ready.

opsbot: reminder: calendar invite created for 2026-03-25 09:00 PT — Trident POC kickoff.
